description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, solid, breathing Pulse, hue-cycling Rainbow, and warm flickering Candle scene previews with bounded 25-400% animation speed controls, optional bounded fade-in and fade-out transitions and administrator cancellation, immediate all-enabled-target preview fan-out with sequential restorative execution and per-target telemetry, credential-free saved-scene preview actions and API resolution against default, selected, or all enabled targets, reusable ordered saved scene playlists with bounded repeat passes, reference-safe rename migration for scheduled cues, dependency-protected playlist and saved-scene deletion, duplicate controls and sequential restorative previews, saved-target diagnostics with selected-channel counts and stale profile ID detection, safe saved-scene duplication with bounded unique names, all-enabled-target scheduled cue fan-out with sequential restorative execution and per-target failure telemetry, cancellable default and per-user Test Connection diagnostics, cancellable System Diagnostics and saved-target validation, saved and scheduled scene cues with credential-free readiness and cancellable manual Run Now actions, deterministic 0-100 scheduled-cue priorities with stable equal-priority ordering, safe per-cue Enable/Disable controls without changing schedule definitions, reversible Skip Next Cue control for one upcoming automatic occurrence without changing future recurrence, bounded missed-cue recovery after short scheduler restarts or outages with explicit recovered-run telemetry, safe Duplicate Cue copies with fresh IDs and reset counters, daily, weekly, monthly-day, monthly-weekday, and yearly recurrence with bounded every-N-day/week/month/year intervals and short-month handling, finite 1-365 execution limits with restart-safe counters and administrator reset/re-enable controls, inherited scene effects, animation speed, and transitions with per-cue duration overrides, recurring and one-time scheduled cues, bounded upcoming occurrence previews with iCalendar export, global scheduled-automation pause/resume with manual Run Now override, optional inclusive date windows and excluded holiday/blackout dates in each cue's time zone, per-cue time zones, DST-aware cue-local and UTC next-run observability, optional persistent cue history, safe scene restoration, credential-safe configuration backup and restore with a cross-server migration wizard, concurrent multi-room playback, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance, color scene, execution, channel, and restoration profiles, advanced color processing, seek recovery, startup recovery, bounded completed-session history with filtering/export/clear and opt-in persistence controls, multi-session telemetry, and auto-reconnection.
